title: Comprehensive scanner FP/correctness audit + post-badge-feature security review
summary: 64-agent workflow audit. Scanner lane: 6 groups swept all 18 lib/scanner/checks/*.ts files, 31 confirmed FP/correctness bugs already fixed with tests (uncommitted, in working tree). Gap lane: security review found 1 critical bug (badge global-scope privacy leak) already fixed, plus 4 lower-severity security findings and 5 prod-readiness findings reported but NOT YET APPLIED. Missing-detector and client/admin feature-gap findings reported directly to the user, not filed as audit findings (product backlog, not security issues).
